Home » Austin Powers 4: Mike Myers Gives Update on Sequel That Dr. Evil Fans Will Love
Mike Myers just delivered a positive update on Austin Powers 4 . The satirical spy comedy series, which kicked off in 1997, featured the actor as the British spy Austin Powers and his arch-nemesis, Dr. Evil . The saga became so popular that fans have since demanded a fourth film. Myers is now here with an update that Dr. Evil fans will love.
In an interview with Hawk Koch for Hollywood Insiders, Myers confirmed that more Dr. Evil content is coming, saying, “Oh, well, there is going to be more Dr. Evil.” The 63-year-old revealed that the latest script focuses on Dr. Evil and his perspective. The actor said, “This one is more from Dr. Evil’s point of view so far.”
Talking about the character, Myers said , “Yeah, it’s a very fun character to do. We just did a commercial from Dr. Evil’s point of view. We’ve actually done two commercials with Dr. Evil, which is super fun.”
Mike Myers recalls the studio’s surprising reaction to Dr. Evil
Surprisingly enough, the studio had an unexpected reaction to Dr. Evil in its first notes. Initially, Myers said, “The funniest thing is I found out that it’s almost 50 -50. People like Dr. Evil as much as they like Austin Powers.”
He then revealed , “One of the craziest things is one of the first studio notes that, after a screening (of the original), was, Less Dr. Evil, people don’t like him because he’s mean to Austin. And I go, ehhh, it got laughs.”
“I mean, I don’t think it’s one of those movies where it’s bad guys-good guys. It’s, you know. So that was one I had to kind of navigate through,” Myers added.
After first hinting at a follow-up in 2024, the Canadian star appeared on a FIFA World Cup livestream watch party in June. When asked whether audiences will see an Austin Powers 4, Myers immediately responded, “Yes.”
It has yet to be revealed when Austin Powers 4 will hit the screens.
